failedGate.cause: Missed SUPERSEDES in one explicit replacement case and omitted all three intended RELATED_TO navigation cases.

retain: The v1 domain-neutral completeness and direction contracts for SUPPORTS, REQUIRES and DERIVED_FROM.
The prohibition on automatically downgrading every rejected strong edge to RELATED_TO.
add: When explicit replacement or repeal language exists, emit SUPERSEDES with its scope; logical contradiction may coexist but cannot replace the governance edge.

RELATED_TO may connect two complementary facets of the same identified object when either endpoint helps navigate to a capability, constraint, comparison, background or boundary at the other endpoint.
A broad identity/definition and a bounded capability detail can be RELATED_TO, but never SUPPORTS solely because they share the object.
An introduction that explicitly points to a following detailed rule can be RELATED_TO when that navigation is useful, while remaining invalid as SUPPORTS.
forbidden: Copying calibration case wording into production prompts.
Any domain, product, source or benchmark identifier.
Relaxing the independent semantic and utility audits.

decisionRules.fail: Reject v2 and restore the pre-Goal4 detector prompt before considering a separately contracted router.
decisionRules.pass: Proceed to the unchanged frozen-source replay gates in the parent contract.
